name: agent-pack
description: Deterministic Agent-extension capability management for configured workspaces.

interface.shortDescription: Inventory, verify, install, sync and migrate Agent Plugins, Skills and MCP servers
interface.longDescription: Deterministic Agent-extension capability manager: inventory / doctor / bootstrap / sync / transfer / reconcile across projects, plugin directories and Codex / Cursor clients. Writes default to dry-run; name clashes and MCP entries that contain secrets fail closed. The project lifecycle (Task/Case/routing/verification/Git) belongs to project-orchestrator, not this plugin. Also ships the agenthelm command line and the user-level runtime. 中文：确定性的 Agent 扩展能力管理器：在项目、插件目录与 Codex / Cursor 客户端之间 inventory / doctor / bootstrap / sync / transfer / reconcile。所有写操作默认 dry-run，重名与含密钥的 MCP 条目失败关闭。项目生命周期（Task/Case/路由/验证/Git）由 project-orchestrator 承担，不在本包内。
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $agent-pack to inventory this project's Agent Plugins, Skills, and MCP servers and report drift against the declared contract.
